$comment: Taxonomy-valued fields carry an x-taxonomy annotation naming the dimension in factory/policies/taxonomy.yml. The runtime validates those values against that file at write time; enums are never inlined here to avoid drift between the schema and the taxonomy (architecture §8).
title: Task Spec
description: A dispatchable task contract: the unit the planner emits and a worker executes. Specs are contracts (architecture §1, §3) — no dispatch without objective, output schema, acceptance criteria, claims, and budget.

plan_version.description: Immutable plan version this task was cut under (architecture §12); never mutated in place.

objective.description: One-paragraph statement of what the task must accomplish.

output_schema_ref.description: Path or $id of the JSON Schema the task's result.structured_output must validate against.

claims.description: File globs this task may touch, computed from static analysis over the target repo (architecture §5). Out-of-claim edits fail the gate.

budget.description: Declared caps for this task. Only fields something can mechanically read belong here — plan validation rejects the rest (src/budgets.ts TASK_BUDGET_FIELD_READERS).

tokens.description: Compared at the gate against the result's token_usage.total_tokens.

diff_lines.description: Compared at the gate against the measured git diff, excluding lockfiles and generated files.

max_turns.description: Still schema-valid so plans written before 2026-08-08 load, but plan validation now rejects it: no dispatch harness can enforce a turn limit (agent-interviews.md M-4). The number belongs in the dispatch prompt, where it is a request.

contract.description: Explicit clauses the worker must satisfy. Nonfunctional/security clauses are always spelled out here — implicit clauses get dropped (error.spec.missing-nonfunctional).

nonfunctional_clauses.description: Explicit security/validation/authz/performance/a11y clauses, even when they seem implied by the objective.

agent_role.description: Role of the agent this task is scoped to be dispatched to.

confidence.description: Set only for origin: inferred tasks (architecture §12); >=0.8 auto-schedules.

dependency_edge_ids.description: IDs of edge-recorded events this task depends on (architecture §7).

project.description: Optional plain-string project identifier (Phase 6b, architecture §8) — NOT a closed taxonomy.yml vocabulary value (projects open/close far more often than any §8 dimension). Absent tasks default to 'black-smith' in the projection layer.
